stem.en: You pull the hook of a spring balance steadily. The pointer settles at 6 N. What does this reading tell you?

text.en: The force of your pull, 6 newtons.

feedback.en: Right. A spring balance reads the magnitude of the pull on its hook.

text.en: How far the spring stretched, in cm.

feedback.en: The scale is marked in newtons, not in centimetres. It shows a force.

text.en: The weight of the spring balance.

feedback.en: The balance reads the force on its hook, here your pull, not its own weight.

explanation.en: A spring balance measures the magnitude of the force on its hook. Here that force is your pull, 6 N.

hints.en: What is marked on the scale of a spring balance?
